correctness.rationale: The p-morphism definition on principal upsets implies every nonroot maps inside a single target chain (the target root upset branches). Each source arm maps surjectively onto a terminal interval, with positive-composition count; the source root lifts iff all target arms are fully covered. Inclusion–exclusion gives both exact formulas and homogeneous falling-factorial moments converge to the Poisson parameter. A standalone verifier independently exhausted 319 small frame comparisons and 319 complete defect profiles; the infinite statement is proved analytically.
